title: Standard configuration
content:
# Standard configuration

Every switch starts from the same building blocks. Apply them in this order:

1. [[Base configuration template]]: hostname, time, logging, management interface, SSH.
2. [[Security baseline]]: AAA, DHCP snooping, disabled web server.
3. [[VLAN plan]]: the VLANs for the site.
4. [[Access and trunk ports]]: port templates for desks, phones, access points and uplinks.

Keep the running configuration identical to the templates wherever possible. Document any exception on the switch's row in [[Switch inventory]] and in the [[Change log]].
